drivers: Three independent attributes to track (count, shape/fill set, rotation), each varied across distractors so partial rule discovery still leaves ambiguity
Count progression (+1 across rows) and Latin-square shape/fill are salient and easy to spot
Rotation rule (decreasing 45° across rows) is subtler and 'upright' vs 45° triangles can be confused
Generous 105 s time limit and all options share the same fill, reducing load
